name: Napa Valley
tagline: Vineyards, small towns, and slow food-focused days.
description: A roughly 30-mile valley of wineries and small towns, from the city of Napa north to Calistoga. Weekends center on wine tasting, long meals, and spa time.

fromSanFrancisco.typicalTravel: About 1–1.5 hours by car, longer with weekend traffic; ferry to Vallejo is an option

gettingAround.summary: Wineries are spread out; most visitors drive, book a tour or driver, or use rideshare. The Vine Trail suits short bike rides.

highlights.title: Yountville and Oxbow Public Market
highlights.note: Destination dining and a casual food hall in Napa.

highlights.title: Wine tasting
highlights.note: Many wineries require advance tasting reservations.

highlights.title: Napa Valley Vine Trail and Bothe-Napa Valley State Park
highlights.note: Easy rides along vineyards and shaded hiking.

highlights.title: Calistoga hot springs and mud baths
highlights.note: Spa-focused town at the north end of the valley.

highlights.title: Winery art collections and galleries
highlights.note: Several wineries and downtown Napa galleries show art.

highlights.title: Downtown Napa music venues
highlights.note: Evening shows in the city of Napa.

weatherNotes: Hot, dry summers and mild, wetter winters; harvest (roughly August to October) is the busiest and priciest time.

demoDailyBudgetPerPersonUsd.note: Fabricated demo range, not a current price.

travelTips: Book tastings ahead; walk-ins are limited at many wineries.
